answer_1.quote: Code summaries are concise natural language descriptions of source code... Finally, the representation of the complete tree, together with source code embedding obtained by a vanilla code token encoder, is fed to a Transformer decoder to generate descriptive summaries.

answer_2.quote: we evaluate the performance of our proposed model based on four widely-used metrics, including BLEU, Meteor, Rouge-L and Cider.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human evaluation ... Each volunteer is asked to assign scores from 0 to 4 (the higher the better) to the generated summary from the three aspects: similarity of the generated summary and the ground truth summary, naturalness (grammaticality and fluency), and informativeness (the amount of content carried over from the input code to the generated summary).
answer_4.guideline: Assign scores from 0 to 4 on similarity, naturalness, and informativeness for each generated summary.
